description: 115年臺南市液化石油氣消防安全檢查及違規取締 [fuel stations and oil and fire, police and emergency services] (series on Taiwan Government Open Data Platform) is a series of datasets listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺南市政府消防局. 本資料集於每季中定期提供前季每月臺南市液化石油氣消防安全檢查及違規取締統計資料。. Coverage: 臺南市政府消防局. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 臺南市政府消防局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, csv. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
